quote: The agent, paying with Archive Writs (a rare surface currency), secured two rooms at an inn run by Bunny.

comments.author: Wario
comments.text: ARCHIVE WRITS. Those are basically golden tickets to the Imperial Vaults. You gave them to a RABBIT for a room?? I am charging you for the mental distress this information caused me.

comments.author: Bunny
comments.text: They're very pretty papers! They make the lobby look much more professional.

comments.text: Professional lobby décor that could buy a small province. PEAK Legion administration. WAH.

quote: Landships were frozen mid-advance, their steam boilers turning into blocks of useless ice before the pressure could even vent.

comments.author: Waluigi
comments.text: Landships. LANDSHIPS! Imagine the insurance claim. 'Cause of loss: Vampire weather adjustment.' WAH.

comments.author: General Ironhand
comments.text: The failure at Blackfen was a technical anomaly, not a strategic one. The landships were under-insulated for high-tier cryomancy.

comments.text: i heard there's still silver in those landships. the ice keeps it fresh.
